text:
Diego M.: Hey all, on my first day trying to follow the quickstart. After SSO I hit a 403 on /api/flags in prod.
Diego M.: curl shows {"error":"forbidden","message":"missing_console_role"} — do new hires need a service account or is this a role issue?
Riley (Infra): Welcome Diego! Usually it's the console role. Share your SSO email and I'll create a JIT access request. Service accounts are only for CI.
Diego M.: diego.m@redwood.ai
Onboarding Bot: Access request created: ONB-4187 by Riley (Infra). Approvers: eng-leads.
Riley (Infra): Approved. If you still see 403, run `curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags 2>&1 | grep x-request-id` and paste the request id.
Diego M.: x-request-id: rq_c4f1aa. Flags still 403 for prod keys.
Priya (Security): Hi @Diego — prod has IP-restricted maintenance endpoints. If JIT didn't fix it, include your public IP in the ticket and we'll add a temporary allowlist. Read-only service accounts are auto-approved for 90 days if you need one.
Riley (Infra): I flipped a short allowlist for Diego's IP; try again. If you're blocked behind corp proxy, use the SSH tunnel: `ssh -NL 8000:console.internal:443 riley@bastion` then open https://localhost:8000.
Diego M.: Tunnel worked, UI loads and I can view prod flags now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): Reminder: include expiry when requesting a service account. We'll auto-approve read-only with 90-day expiry.
Diego M.: Filed follow-up to request a demo service account. All good for now, closing.
